I'm Jon — an independent web designer based in Bordeaux[[bordeaux]], though I'm originally from Jersey[[jersey]] in the Channel Islands and lived in Paris and Brighton along the way. I've been doing this for over 25 years, working across strategy, design and development, which is a slightly unusual combination for a designer.

Outside of work I'm a keen street photographer, I collect photography books, I love to cook, and I used to DJ — music's always on while I work.
